entries.en: Seemed like a routine patrol until the geth hit us. We never knew they were coming.
I don't know. They set up camp near the beacon. The 232 was with them. Maybe their unit fared better than mine.
There aren't any turians on Eden Prime. None that I've ever met. Not sure I'd be able to tell if one was a Spectre, anyway.
If you saw this guy, you'd know. Carries enough firepower to wipe out a whole platoon. Luckily, he's on our side.
Sorry. Like I said, no turians.
Are you wounded, Williams?
Give me a status report, Williams.
This isn't your fault, Williams. You couldn't have done anything to save them.
Any idea what kind of enemy we're facing?
You just left the rest of your unit behind to die?
We could use your help, Williams.
You're coming with us, Williams. We need that beacon.
Lieutenant Alenko and I will take care of this.
Welcome aboard, Williams.
Just don't forget who's in charge.
Tell me everything you know about the beacon.
Describe what happened leading up to the attack.
What happened to the researchers at the dig site?
Have you seen a turian Spectre around here?
What happened here?
Fighting these things?
You abandoned them.
Join us.
Take us there.
Stay here.
Fine, come with us.
Before the attack
And the scientists?
We tried to get off a distress call, but they cut off our communications. I've been fighting for my life ever since.
The geth haven't been seen outside the Veil in nearly 200 years. Why are they here now?
They must have come for the beacon.
I need a status report. Now.
Where's the rest of your squad?
We're on a mission.
What happened to your unit?
What killed them?
Suddenly, every scientific expert in the colony was interested. That's when they brought us in to secure the site.
Staff Lieutenant Kaidan Alenko. Glad to have you on the team.
Just what I remember from history class back in school. They're synthetics. Non-organic life-forms with limited AI programming created by the quarians a few centuries ago.
They were supposed to be a source of cheap labor, but ended up turning on the quarians and drove them into exile.
After that, they just kind of disappeared behind the Perseus Veil. Nobody's really heard much from them since.
What else do you know about the geth?
Gunnery Chief Ashley Williams of the 212. You the one in charge here, ma'am?
Yes, ma'am. We held our position as long as we could. Until the geth overwhelmed us.
Let me come with you, ma'am. The geth slaughtered my unit. Give me a chance to get even!
Aye, aye, ma'am. It's time for payback.
The beacon's at the far end of this trench.
Looks like the geth beat us to it.
Then I guess we better take it back!
Change of plans, Shepard. There's a small spaceport up ahead.
I want to check it out. I'll wait for you there.
Sounds like Nihlus already knew the beacon wasn't here.
This is the dig site. The beacon was right here. It must have been moved.
By who? Our side? Or the geth?
Hard to say. Maybe we'll know more after we check out the research camp.
If they were lucky. Maybe hiding up in the camp.
It's just on the top of this ridge. Up the ramps.
Let's get moving. Williams, where's the camp?
You think anyone got out of here alive?
We make for the camp.
Any survivors?
Let's go there.
Humans! Thank the Maker!
Hurry! Close the door! Before they come back!
How did you end up in this shed?
Thank you. I think we'll be okay now. It looks like everyone's gone.
You're Dr. Warren, the one in charge of the excavation. Do you know what happened to the beacon?
I'm Dr. Warren. I was in charge of this excavation. We hid in the shed during the attack. They must have come for the beacon.
Luckily, it wasn't here. It was moved to the spaceport earlier this morning. Manuel and I stayed behind to pack up the camp.
No one is saved. The age of humanity is ended. Soon, only ruin and corpses will remain.
You can't stop it. Nobody can stop it. Night is falling. The darkness of eternity.
Hush, Manuel. Go lie down. You'll feel better once the medication kicks in.
Yes? Is there something you need?
I saw him. The prophet. Leader of the enemy. He was here, before the attack.
That's impossible. Nihlus was with us on the Normandy before the attack. He couldn't have been here.
I'm sorry. Manuel's still a bit... unsettled. We haven't seen your turian. We've been hiding in here since the attack.
Manuel has a brilliant mind, but he's always been a bit... unstable. Genius and madness are two sides of the same coin.
I gave him an extra dose of his meds after the attack.
Luck won't save you.
Don't worry. We'll protect you.
What are you doing here?
Williams, take us to the spaceport.
Can you tell me anything about the beacon?
What else can you tell me about the attack?
Did you notice a turian in the area?
What's wrong with your assistant?
We better get moving.
You're safe.
Assistant
It's some type of data module from a galaxy-wide communications network. Remarkably well-preserved. It could be the greatest scientific discovery of our lifetime!
It all happened so fast. One second we were gathering up our equipment. The next we were hiding in the shed while the geth swarmed over the camp.
Agents of the destroyers. Bringers of darkness. Heralds of our extinction.
We could hear the battle outside. Gunfire. Screams. I thought it would never end. Then, everything went quiet. We just sat there, too afraid to move. Until you came along.
No. I'm sorry. We haven't left the shed since the attack.
Is it madness to see the future? To see the destruction rushing towards us? To understand there is no escape? No hope? No, I am not mad. I'm the only sane one left!
Oh my God! What did you do?
You can't just go around whacking people in the head!
That might've been a little extreme, Commander.
I suppose you're right. By the time he wakes up, the meds will have kicked in.
The attack triggered one of his episodes. Short of a headache when he wakes up, he should be okay.
Say goodnight, Manuel.
Just a little bump on the head. Let him sleep it off.
I can shut him up!
He's okay.
You cannot silence the truth! My voice must be heard-- ungh!
We hid here during the attack. They must have come here for the beacon.
Miraculous new technologies. Groundbreaking medical advances. Who knows what secrets are locked inside?
We have unearthed the heart of evil. Awakened the beast. Unleashed the darkness.
Manuel! Please! This isn't the time.
Who knows what secrets are locked inside? Miraculous new technologies. Groundbreaking medical advances. The possibilities are endless!
It was moved to the spaceport this morning. Manuel and I stayed behind to help pack up the camp.
When the attack came, the marines held them off long enough for us to hide. They gave their lives to save us.
It was only a matter of time until he did something crazy. And dangerous.
He's better off.
He had it coming.
You're wasting your time. The age of humanity is over. Our extinction is inevitable.
Zzz... zzzz... zzzz.
It's probably best if you just leave him alone.
Time? Our time is over.
That was a little extreme, Commander.
Manuel, I need to ask you something.
Time to shut you up!
The darkness is coming. The end is near. You can't-- ungh!
Looks like they hit the camp hard.
It's a good place for an ambush. Keep your guard up.
That door. It's closed. Security lock's engaged.
Might be survivors hiding inside. I think I can hack into the system and override the lock.
Oh, god! They're still alive!
What did the geth do to them?
I don't think those spikes are geth technology...
Everybody stay calm out there. We're coming out. We're not armed.
Is it safe? Are they gone?
Nice going, Cole! I told you we should've stayed hidden.
It's okay. We're all on the same side here. We're just farmers. We've been hiding ever since that ship first showed up.
It showed up right before the attack. Knew it was trouble the second I saw it. So we made a break for the sheds.
You need something?
I was too busy running to get a clear look at it. I think it landed over near the spaceport.
Tell them about the noise, Cole. That awful noise.
It was emitting some kind of signal as it descended. Sounded like the shriek of the damned. Only it was coming from inside your own head.
The three of us were working the crops when that ship showed up. We just saw it and ran. I don't know what happened to the rest of the crew.
You don't know that! We survived. If they made it to the garage, they could've had a fighting chance!
We're just farmers. We heard they found something out there, but it never really mattered to us. Not until now.
Hey, Cole. We're just a bunch of farmers. These guys are soldiers. Maybe we should give them the stuff.
Geez, Blake. You gotta learn when to shut up!
Some guys at the spaceport were running a small smuggling ring. Nothing major. In exchange for a cut of the profits, we let them store packages in our sheds.
We're not hurting anybody! Hell, most of the time, I don't even know what's in the packages. I just thought there might be something we could use.
Good luck.
You're okay now. Nobody's going to hurt you.
Nobody moves a muscle until we know who you are!
We took care of them.
